title: Connors 3-day lower highs and lows pullback in 200-day uptrend

source.title: Larry Connors 3-day high/low method (TradingView open-source script)

rule_summary: Daily signals from closed UTC daily candles built from 1h data, executed at the next 1h open. ENTRY when a daily candle closes with: close > SMA(200 days); close < SMA(5 days); and three consecutive days of falling range, meaning each of the last three daily candles has both a lower high and a lower low than the candle before it (today vs yesterday, yesterday vs two days ago, two days ago vs three days ago); and no open position. EXIT when a daily close is above SMA(5 days). Safety exit: daily close below SMA(200 days) or 12% below entry. Long only, one position per pair, whole balance, no add-ons (the source's optional add-on is excluded).
mechanism: Three successive days of lower highs and lows inside a long-term uptrend is a short-lived selling streak. Impatient sellers and stop-triggered holders push price below its short mean, and buyers who provide liquidity are paid when price snaps back to the 5-day mean. The source states no mechanism; this is the standard short-term reversal explanation.
